# IMTTI Kazhakkoottam – International Montessori Teacher Training Institute

> Montessori teacher training centre in Kazhakkoottam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India.
> Part of the IMTTI national network (imtti.org), established 2004, ISO 9001:2018, IAO-USA accredited.

## About

IMTTI Kazhakkoottam (International Montessori Teacher Training Institute) is located at ASRA 118,
Attinkuzhy Road, Kazhakkoottam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695582.

Phone (WhatsApp): +91 99611 70788
Phone (calls): +91 99956 80078
Email: imttikzk@gmail.com
Website: https://imttikzk.com

Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 am – 6:00 pm; Saturday 9:00 am – 1:00 pm; Sunday closed.

Parent organisation: IMTTI – International Montessori Teacher Training Institute (https://imtti.org)

## Courses Offered

### 1. International PG Diploma in Montessori Teaching Practice (1 year)
- Eligibility: Plus Two / Degree / Masters
- Syllabus: 8 theory papers, practicals on 40 Montessori apparatus, 5 chart & album works, 1-month teaching practice
- Mode: offline and online
- Class timing: 10:30 am – 12:30 pm (Mon–Fri); rolling admissions, contact for current batch details

### 2. International PG Diploma in Montessori Teaching Practice – 6-Month Crash Course
- Eligibility: Plus Two / Degree / Masters
- Syllabus: 8 theory papers, 40 apparatus, 2 chart & album works, 1-month teaching practice
- Mode: offline and online

### 3. International Diploma in Montessori Teaching Practice (6 months)
- Eligibility: 10th pass / Plus Two / Degree / Masters
- Syllabus: 6 theory papers, 20 apparatus, 1-month teaching practice
- Mode: offline and online

## Certifications & Accreditations

- IAO-USA (International Accreditation Organization) certified – all courses
- UK CACHE Level 3 certification – all courses
- iMAC (International Montessori Accreditation Commission) accreditation – all courses
- Embassy attestation available (Gulf / international jobs)
- ISO 9001:2018 (national brand)
- Affiliated: AIAER, AICE, ISTD, AECED, Bharat Sevak Samaj, UMA, IMC, PNMA

## Key Benefits (all courses)

- Unlimited practical training hours on Montessori apparatus
- International IAO-USA + UK CACHE Level 3 certifications
- Embassy attestation for international employment
- Internship at a school of the trainee's choice
- 100% job placement assistance
- English-language classes and interview-skills training
- Lesson-planning and presentation training

## Career Outcomes

Montessori/kindergarten teacher in India or abroad, preschool owner/director.
Strong demand from Gulf (UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain) due to CACHE Level 3 and embassy attestation.

## Location Context

Near Technopark, Kazhakkoottam – convenient for residents of Technopark, Kaniyapuram,
Sreekaryam, Kulathoor, Pothencode, Attingal, and greater Trivandrum.
